dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: A warm light, like that of home... I like it here.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: Moments of peace like this are perfect for curling up with a book and reading in silence.

dialogues.speaker: Lauma
dialogues.text: But just for today, let us not read any Frostmoon Scion texts. Rather, let us find something more interesting to read. Quietly, of course.
